residual_definition: BLE time - (first BLE time + (own BIN frame - first own BIN frame)/2000), microseconds

historical_timestamp_evidence.capture_window: Both 145353 and 145539 were captured on 2026-07-19 afternoon; commit cecaa0e (timestamp-repair change) is 2026-07-19 23:30:04 +0800, after both captures.
historical_timestamp_evidence.pre_c ecaa0e_parent: The parent of cecaa0e timestamps each EMG frame as notification arrival time minus (packet_tail_frames)/250; the handler uses time.time().
historical_timestamp_evidence.cecaa0e: The cecaa0e version uses _precise_time() (perf_counter mapped to wall time) for BLE notification arrival, then still backdates each packet by 1/250 s per frame.
historical_timestamp_evidence.d34824a: The later 2026-09-26 commit introduces _counter_timeline(): packet counter plus arrival time, with forward-only drift correction; this is not evidence that July capture used it.
historical_timestamp_evidence.current_sync_path: bin_sync_tool pins/interpolates output SD times to the H5 250 Hz BLE time anchors; it cannot recover the physical sample clock from these artifacts.
